description: Free, no key, no wallet: read on-chain facts about any Elysium token before you trade it. Returns { token, chainId, screened: false, sellTest, hookFee, liquidity, creator, launchpad, template, forcedTransfer, meaning }: sellTest { class, result, blockedAt, complete, variantsRun, variantsSkipped, lossPct, method, sizes [{ amount, result, lossPct }], extraLossPctAtLargerSize, buyTaxPct, transfer { ok, backOk, taxPct }, sellLossPct, logsMatchBalances, delayed { clockAdvancedMinutes, result }, note }: a simulation at the time of the read that tries to buy, approve, transfer wallet to wallet and back, and sell from both wallets, as separate transactions, through the pools Trnch would route through (the proven launch pool, the deepest and the oldest qualifying pool; the worst result decides: decidingPool, poolTested, checkedAt), at two sizes and again with the clock advanced 5 minutes in simulation; note says in words what actually ran, complete, variantsRun and variantsSkipped say what did not and why, and a partial result reads "(partial check)"; class sold (bought, transferred and sold in a simulation, every step that ran succeeded), taxed, blocked (blockedAt says whether the approval or the sell failed in the simulation), transfer-failed (the tokens could not be moved between wallets in the simulation) or not-checked; buy tax, transfer tax and sell loss are reported apart, and token logs that do not match balances are reported. A simulation now: the token may behave differently later or towards other wallets, and an upgradeable or owner-controlled token can change; sizes 0.25 HYPE and, when the pool is deep enough, 1.5 HYPE; poolTested { id, feeBps, hook, launchpad, poolThinForSize, depthLowerBound }; decidingPool { id, roles, why }; poolsTested; poolsTruncated; checkedAt; hookFee { buyBps, sellBps } when the pool has a launch hook; liquidity { found, usdEstimate }; creator { launches }: how many tokens the same creator launched before this one; launchpad { result, hook, proof }: the launchpad of the pool tested, named only when proven ("Montra", "Boxa", "Kleos"; a verified contract name alone reads "<Name> (contract name)"), otherwise "hook not identified" or "no hook", a fact about origin, never a signal by itself; hookRisk { result }: what the hook of that pool can take, read on chain where readable: "launch fee window: up to N%, ends in M min", "hook tax: N% buy, M% sell" or "hook can tax up to N%", null when there is nothing to say; template { result, implementation, upgradeable }: "Montra template" when the token is a clone of that launchpad's token, "clone, template not identified", "upgradeable proxy" (its code can be replaced after the read) or "custom contract"; forcedTransfer { result, rolesTried, callsTried }: whether the declared owner or the creator could move or burn a buyer's tokens without approval in a simulation, trying only transferFrom without allowance and burn (other owner powers are not tried), "none found", "found: <reason>" or "not checked: <why>". A fact that could not be read says "not checked: <why>". Facts, not a verdict: Trnch runs no rug screen on this chain.
name: trnch_check
title: Token facts read on chain
